response.sql:
WITH account_avgs AS (
  SELECT account_id, AVG(amount) as avg_amount
  FROM trans
  GROUP BY account_id
),
region_avgs AS (
  SELECT d.A3 as region, AVG(aa.avg_amount) as region_avg
  FROM account_avgs aa
  JOIN account a ON aa.account_id = a.account_id
  JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
  GROUP BY d.A3
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(region_avg) as overall_avg
  FROM region_avgs
),
above_average AS (
  SELECT ra.region, ra.region_avg
  FROM region_avgs ra, overall_avg oa
  WHERE ra.region_avg > oa.overall_avg
),
above_average_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(region_avg) as above_avg_figure
  FROM above_average
)
SELECT 
  aa.region,
  aa.region_avg as figure,
  aa.region_avg - oa.overall_avg as exceeds_by,
  aa.region_avg / aaa.above_avg_figure as ratio_to_above_avg
FROM above_average aa
CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa
CROSS JOIN above_average_avg aaa
ORDER BY aa.region

assumptions.assumption: All rows from the trans table are included in the per-account averages, regardless of their type or operation field. The verified note indicates that some transaction types (like VYBER) have undocumented direction, but since the request specifies 'average its transaction amounts' without explicit filtering by type, all amounts in trans.amount are included as-is.
